tasks.label: Open firewall ports 3000,8001-8003
args: New-NetFirewallRule -DisplayName 'Ollantay Web (3000)' -Direction Inbound -LocalPort 3000 -Protocol TCP -Action Allow -EdgeTraversalPolicy Allow; New-NetFirewallRule -DisplayName 'Ollantay API (8001-8003)' -Direction Inbound -LocalPort 8001-8003 -Protocol TCP -Action Allow -EdgeTraversalPolicy Allow
